resources.string: On: it can change settings, manage apps and work on a hidden screen
Tap here, switch on Wireless debugging, tap “Pair device with pairing code”, and type the six digits into Momoding\'s notification. Momoding does the rest
Wireless debugging is off: tap to switch it back on (no need to pair again)

It uses Android\'s own wireless debugging, the phone pairing with itself: nothing else to install, no computer. Set it up once: after a restart Momoding brings it back by itself, on a Wi-Fi you allowed.
In Wireless debugging, tap “Pair device with pairing code”, then type the six digits here (tap “Enter code”)
Pairing timed out. Try again from Momoding.
That code didn\'t work or has expired. Enter the code shown now.
The pairing code is six digits. Enter it again.
Keep the pairing dialog open, then enter the code.
Type the six-digit code from the pairing dialog here
Settings → About phone: tap the build number 7 times
Switch it on; in the dialog tick “Always allow on this network”, then Allow
Tap “Pair device with pairing code” and type the six digits into Momoding\'s notification

Xiaomi / Redmi: without “USB debugging (Security settings)” on, advanced access cannot grant permissions to apps (the permission card takes you to the system dialog instead); everything else works. Turning that on needs a SIM card and a Xiaomi account.
